page.overview:
What is Plushtrap Chaser?

is a line of animatronic toy rabbits. One of them serves as the main antagonist of Out of Stock, the third story of Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch.

Plushtrap Chasers are furry dark green animatronic rabbit toys which stand at three feet tall. They have plastic eyes that bulge out of wide eye sockets, making their faces appear skeletal. Plushtrap Chasers also have pointed canine-looking teeth, whiskers, and long, crooked ears. They have jointed arms and legs and are relatively light, mainly weighed down by their heads and oversized feet. Under the fur on their backs is a line of Velcro closed over a battery compartment, which takes 9-volt batteries. There’s a little black switch on their feet. On the side of their metal jaws is a charging port.

The main Plushtrap Chaser in Out of Stock is defective. It has straight, slightly yellow human teeth, which are set in human gums. The Plushtrap Chaser also has cloudy green human eyes. The battery compartment is corroded with white crust. Below the compartment is a pattern of small holes for a speaker. As it bites into things, its human teeth sharpen and bleed, gleaming in the darkness.

The unused illustration shows the main one as yellow-green animatronic rabbit. Its eyes are plastic and bulging, its mouth is filled with pointed teeth, and its ears are jointed.
